crossRefs.note: Then David gave to Solomon his son the plans for the porch of the temple, for its houses, for its treasuries, for its…
and the plans of all that he had by the Spirit, for the courts of Yahweh’s house, for all the surrounding rooms, for…
See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.
You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain.
Yahweh’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and…
So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and Yahweh’s hand was…
Yahweh’s hand was there on me; and he said to me, “Arise, go out into the plain, and I will talk with you there.”

translations.web: “All this”, David said, “I have been made to understand in writing from Yahweh’s hand, even all the works of this pattern.”
translations.bsb: “All this,” said David, “all the details of this plan, the LORD has made clear to me in writing by His hand upon me.”
translations.kjv: All this, said David, the LORD made me understand in writing by his hand upon me, even all the works of this pattern.
translations.asv: All this, said David, have I been made to understand in writing from the hand of Jehovah, even all the works of this pattern.
